Copy its rendering technique AND her face, hair and colours exactly (ignore its circle, its lettering and its spark symbol). Image 2 is her full character sheet. CHARACTER: Xiao Ke. A young woman, calm and gentle, with a faint smile. Very long straight hair. An orange chrysanthemum-like flower hair ornament with a dark ribbon and a tassel. A high ruffled collar with a dark cravat and a flower brooch, a cream capelet with a flower emblem, a dark corset belt with a thin chain, a long layered skirt with an orange front panel and embroidered hem, and lace-up heeled boots. She carries her dark leather book.

- warm cream #F0EEE6 (skin, blouse, capelet, skirt, highlights)
- pale apricot #F2C6A8 (light shadows on the cream parts, flower centres)
- Claude terracotta orange #D97757 (hair, flowers, the orange skirt panel, embroidery)
